question.text:
Match the polymers in column-A with their main uses in column-B and choose the correct answer:
 
  Column - A   Column - B
A. Polystyrene i. Paints and lacquers
B. Glyptal ii. Rain coats
C. Polyvinyl chloride  iii. Manufacture of toys
D. Bakelite iv. Computer discs

options.text: A - iii , B - i , C - ii , D - iv
A - ii , B - i , C - iii , D - iv
A - ii , B - iv , C - iii , D - i
A - iii , B - iv , C - ii , D - i

solution.text:
Polystyrene is a synthetic aromatic hydrocarbon polymer.Polystyrene is clear, hard, and rather brittle.
Glyptal is a polyester obtained by condensation polymerization of glycerol and phthalic anhydride.
Bakelite is electrical nonconductivity and heat-resistant.
Polyvinyl Chloride is a high strength thermoplastic material.

The correct order is
 ​

  Column - A   Column - B
A. Polystyrene iii. Manufacture of toys
B. Glyptal i. Paints and lacquers
C. Polyvinyl chloride chloride ii. Raincoats
D. Bakelite iv. Computer discs
